initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 28/40 − 48/60 = −0.1. R293-2 supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the causal effect. The population table and successful arithmetic checks therefore do not uniquely determine the requested average causal risk difference.
